facts.text: I am trying to understand the process for adjusting my status to a green card.
I had a meeting with a lawyer about adjusting my status to a green card.
I submitted my asylum application 21 months ago.
I have questions about the typical timeframe for the asylum and green card adjustment process.
I want to know what documents are required for an AOS application.
I want to know whether there are specific requirements for asylum seekers for the AOS application.
I am unclear about the proof of continuous presence requirement for my AOS application.
I want to know what documents are acceptable to prove continuous presence.
I want to know whether there is a specific timeframe for the continuous presence documents.
I am unclear about the affidavit from friends or family members for my AOS application.
I want information on what friends or family members need to include in the affidavit letter and how it should be formatted.
I want to know how detailed the affiant needs to be when describing interactions with me in the affidavit.
I want to know whether the affiant needs to provide specific dates or whether a general idea of how often we have seen each other is sufficient.
I want to know whether an affiant who is not a US citizen or permanent resident can still provide an affidavit.
I want to know what specific requirements or considerations apply if the affiant is not a US citizen or permanent resident.
